ownership.summary: Miele is privately owned by the Miele and Zinkann founding families. The company's current management page describes around 80 family stakeholders who are direct descendants of founders Carl Miele and Reinhard Zinkann. A 2017 Miele disclosure reported a 51% Miele-family and 49% Zinkann-family split, but the current pages reviewed do not restate a current percentage table. Miele & Cie. KG is managed by two family co-proprietors and four non-family executive directors on an equal executive footing.

productPortfolio.name: Vacuum cleaners and cordless floorcare
productPortfolio.positioning: Bagged and bagless canisters, cordless Triflex and Duoflex systems, robot vacuums and floor-cleaning extensions form Miele's consumer floorcare offer.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Premium positioning depends on model-specific filtration, batteries, tools, bags, rollers, parts and service availability.

productPortfolio.name: Laundry, dishwashing and kitchen appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Washing machines, tumble dryers, dishwashers, cooking, refrigeration and coffee systems make Miele a broad premium home-appliance brand.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: The wider installed base supports dealer and service relationships but uses category-specific factories, parts and compliance files.

productPortfolio.name: Miele Professional
productPortfolio.positioning: Commercial laundry, dishwashing, laboratory and medical cleaning and disinfection equipment serve professional customers.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Professional products require qualification, installation, validation and service arrangements distinct from consumer appliance channels.

productPortfolio.name: Digital services, accessories and consumables
productPortfolio.positioning: Miele app services, detergents, vacuum bags, filters and care products support the installed hardware base.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Lifecycle value depends on software support and market-specific access to genuine consumables, spare parts and trained service.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Miele's March 2026 business-development page described a global network of 19 production plants and 49 sales and service subsidiaries.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not use the group totals to identify the plant for a specific model; verify the product label and technical file.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Miele's Bielefeld factory produces vacuum cleaners as well as domestic and professional cleaning and disinfection equipment.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the claimed German factory to the exact model, production period and factory record.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Miele's wholly owned Dongguan factory lists Swing H1, Compact C1, Compact C2 and Complete C2 vacuum-cleaner ranges and uses motors supplied from Euskirchen.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Treat this as current range-level evidence, not proof that every Miele vacuum is made in China or Germany.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Miele's official production directory lists differentiated sites across Germany and other countries, each with distinct product and component roles.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the manufacturer, assembly site, component origin, importer and traceability documents for the contracted SKU.

marketsChannels.evidence: Miele operates country subsidiaries, direct websites, showrooms, authorized dealers and kitchen-studio relationships.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the seller's authorization, model-market fit, installation scope and local warranty.

marketsChannels.evidence: Miele Professional uses specialist sales, project, service and application-support routes for commercial and institutional customers.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Define commissioning, validation, training, uptime, consumables and response obligations in the contract.

marketsChannels.evidence: Regional subsidiaries can act as the seller, importer, service provider or digital-service party without changing the group's founding-family ownership.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the exact entity responsible for the order, data service, warranty and after-sales support.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Miele's advantage combines premium brand trust, long family ownership, a broad appliance base, professional applications and significant in-house manufacturing. In floorcare, however, Dyson and fast-moving Chinese brands set a rapid cordless and wet-cleaning feature cycle. Miele must translate durability, filtration, service and system quality into visibly competitive products while avoiding unsupported country-of-origin assumptions across its German and international plants.
